name: Swasanandam Gulika (Vati)

sections.introduction: Swasanandam gulika is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to have mixture of effective herbs. This is known to treat the problems related to respiratory system.
sections.ingredients:
Triphala – Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amalaki (Emblica officinalis), Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Karpoora – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (An ore of Mercury and Sulphur) 
 Vatsanabha – Purified and processed Aconitum ferox 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the herbs and powder them. 
 At last mix all the powdered herbs and make pills from them by taking the quantity of mixture up to 125 mg. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Swasanandam gulika is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. This medicine is meant to manage the respiratory complications. Herbs used in the formulation of this are packed with antimicrobial properties that protect the body from various infections. Use of this medicine is quite effective to manage health issues like asthma, bronchitis, cough etc. Expectorant and decongestant action of this medicine helps to clear the phlegm, cough, mucous from air ways and air channels. It manages the symptoms with bronchitis like wheezing, persistent cough, low fever and chills, chest tightening, sore throat, body aches, breathlessness, blocked nose, headache and sinuses etc.
sections.dose: One to two tablets, two times a day, after meals.
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Gastritis problem may arise in over dose. 
 Take under medical prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Swasanandam Gulika (Vati) 
 Reference – Arogyakalpadrumam. 
 Introduction 
 Swasanandam gulika is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to have mixture of effective herbs. This is known to treat the problems related to respiratory system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Triphala – Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amalaki (Emblica officinalis), Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Karpoora – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (An ore of Mercury and Sulphur) 
 Vatsanabha – Purified and processed Aconitum ferox 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the herbs and powder them. 
 At last mix all the powdered herbs and make pills from them by taking the quantity of mixture up to 125 mg. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Swasanandam gulika is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. This medicine is meant to manage the respiratory complications. Herbs used in the formulation of this are packed with antimicrobial properties that protect the body from various infections. Use of this medicine is quite effective to manage health issues like asthma, bronchitis, cough etc. Expectorant and decongestant action of this medicine helps to clear the phlegm, cough, mucous from air ways and air channels. It manages the symptoms with bronchitis like wheezing, persistent cough, low fever and chills, chest tightening, sore throat, body aches, breathlessness, blocked nose, headache and sinuses etc. 
 Indications 
 
 Cold and cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 
 Dose 
 One to two tablets, two times a day, after meals. 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Gastritis problem may arise in over dose. 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
